policies.title: Grenada: Sudanese ordinary passports
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy nationality schedule assigns Sudanese visitors to its Prior to Arrival category, defined as a visa obtained from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Sudanese passport for short visitor travel.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
Work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment are outside this classification.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.

policies.title: Panama: Sudanese ordinary passports
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Sudan in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring consular filing and approval before travel unless a separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Sudanese passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
The Embassy says authorized-visa applicants must appear in person at the consulate; approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, invitation and final-admission treatment are outside this classification.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on verification and document completion.
steps: Determine that the separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Appear in person at the competent Panamanian consulate with the required authorized-visa application documents.
Do not finalize travel arrangements until the authorized visa has been granted.
